scenes.text: What happens when the night doesn’t cool?
To fall asleep, the body needs to cool down. On hot nights, sleep comes later and ends sooner.
A study of forty-seven thousand people’s sleep wristbands, in sixty-eight countries, found that hot nights cut sleep.
A bad night means a harder next day: the body starts already tired, with no reserve for the heat.
Cool nights are part of protection.
